questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
a = 4
b = a
a = a + 1
print(a + b)
```
questions.explain: b gets its own copy of 4. Then a becomes 5, and b stays 4, so a + b = 9.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
total, k = 0, 10
while k > 0:
    total += k
    k -= 3
print(total)
```
questions.explain: k takes the values 10, 7, 4 and 1 before reaching −2, so total = 10 + 7 + 4 + 1 = 22.

questions.stem: In C, what does a pointer holding NULL point to?
options: The first node of the list
Nothing, so reading through it is an error
The last node that was allocated
questions.explain: NULL means the pointer refers to no object at all, so dereferencing it is invalid. That is why NULL marks the end of a list.
